Skips URLs matching the exclude path pattern

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'exclude_paths' => ['/admin/.*'], 'max_depth' => 1, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages.length.inspect
```
